intent: Portable context bundle for Memoria domain work; preserves canonical subjects, claims, relationships, lexicalizations, evidence links, documents, and views.

type_cards.label: about
type_cards.description: The source record is about, describes, or directly concerns the target subject.

type_cards.label: addresses
type_cards.description: The source subject is intended to handle, resolve, or respond to the target subject.

type_cards.label: classified as
type_cards.description: The source subject is an instance or member of the target classifier concept.

type_cards.label: contradicts
type_cards.description: The source subject or claim conflicts with or challenges the target subject, claim, or relationship.

type_cards.label: extracts
type_cards.description: The source process or operation identifies and pulls the target subject from source material.

type_cards.label: governs
type_cards.description: The source principle, rule, or practice constrains or guides the target process, operation, or behavior.

type_cards.label: normalizes
type_cards.description: The source process or operation standardizes the target subject into a canonical form.

type_cards.label: part of
type_cards.description: The source subject is a component, phase, step, or substructure of the target subject.

type_cards.label: performs
type_cards.description: The source process, operation, actor, or system carries out the target practice, function, or activity.

type_cards.label: phase of
type_cards.description: The source subject is a named phase within the target process or cycle.

type_cards.label: precedes
type_cards.description: The source subject comes before the target subject in an ordered process or sequence.

type_cards.label: produces
type_cards.description: The source subject creates, yields, or outputs the target subject.

type_cards.label: relates to
type_cards.description: The source subject has a meaningful but currently unspecified connection to the target subject.

type_cards.label: structures
type_cards.description: The source subject organizes or gives shape to the target subject.

type_cards.label: supports
type_cards.description: The source subject or claim provides support for the target subject, claim, or relationship.

type_cards.label: uses
type_cards.description: The source subject depends on, applies, or makes use of the target subject.

type_cards.label: Actor
type_cards.description: A person, organization, system, or agent capable of acting.

type_cards.label: Artifact
type_cards.description: A produced or maintained work product, surface, bundle, registry, index, or representation derived from or used by graph state.

type_cards.label: Concept
type_cards.description: An idea, category, method, principle, phase, operation, or abstraction.

type_cards.label: Event
type_cards.description: A bounded occurrence or change that happens at a time or within a process.

type_cards.label: Object
type_cards.description: A concrete artifact, document, product, tool, system, or versioned thing.

type_cards.label: Operation
type_cards.description: A bounded action or procedure performed within a process or phase to transform, validate, normalize, admit, or produce something.

type_cards.label: Phase
type_cards.description: A major stage within a process that groups related operations and changes the process state toward its outcome.

type_cards.label: Primitive
type_cards.description: A core semantic record or graph building block that belongs to Memoria canonical state, such as a subject, claim, edge, evidence, lexicalization, domain, or cluster.

type_cards.label: Principle
type_cards.description: A governing rule, heuristic, invariant, or design commitment that shapes how processes, operations, or graph records should behave.

type_cards.label: Process
type_cards.description: An organized flow of work or activity that unfolds over time, coordinates operations or phases, and transforms inputs, state, or understanding toward an outcome.

type_cards.label: Step
type_cards.description: A discrete unit of work within an operation, phase, or process, usually ordered or reviewable as part of a larger workflow.

subjects.label: Admission
subjects.description: The process of governing admission to a knowledge base or knowledge graph.

original.label: Admission
original.description: The process of governing admission to a knowledge base or knowledge graph.

subjects.label: Authoring
subjects.description: Human shaping that applies salience through naming, selecting, and drawing structure.

subjects.label: Canonical Memory
subjects.description: The durable accepted body of Memoria knowledge after candidate material has been reviewed, admitted, and promoted.

subjects.label: Claim
subjects.description: The durable proposition layer that records statements about subjects, relations, attributes, temporal conditions, contradictions, or open questions.

original.label: Claim
original.description: The durable proposition layer that records statements about subjects, relations, attributes, temporal conditions, contradictions, or open questions.

subjects.label: Claim Extraction
subjects.description: A distillation operation that converts source material into explicit propositions.

original.label: Claim Extraction
original.description: A distillation process step that turns source material into explicit propositions while preserving causal, temporal, ordered, contradictory, and uncertain structure.

subjects.label: Claim Merge
subjects.description: A distillation process step that merges accepted claims into canonical state without deleting prior valid claims.

original.label: Claim Merge
original.description: A distillation process step that merges accepted claims into canonical state without deleting prior valid claims.

subjects.label: Containment
subjects.description: A principle for modeling membership or part-whole inclusion.

subjects.label: Context
subjects.description: The principle of context holds that a fact's meaning and validity depend on the conditions surrounding it

original.label: Context
original.description: A grouping or scope structure over subjects and claims, including curated domains, curated collections, inferred clusters, and checkout bundles.

subjects.label: Context Curation
subjects.description: A distillation process step that reviews and curates context changes, including domain proposals and domain hierarchy changes.

original.label: Context Curation
original.description: A distillation process step that reviews and curates context changes, including domain proposals and domain hierarchy changes.

subjects.label: Context Proposal
subjects.description: A distillation process step that proposes groupings, domain candidates, and subdomain suggestions without making them canonical automatically.

original.label: Context Proposal
original.description: A distillation process step that proposes groupings, domain candidates, and subdomain suggestions without making them canonical automatically.

subjects.label: Conversion
subjects.description: An operation in the Preparation phase that converts source material into its leanest machine-efficient form without adding meaning.

subjects.label: Converted Source
subjects.description: A source artifact produced by conversion that preserves source material in a lossless, machine-efficient working format before cleaning, chunking, or extraction.

subjects.label: Distillation Methodology
subjects.description: The framework that governs Knowledge Distillation practice.

subjects.label: Entity Map
subjects.description: A capture guide for extracting or admitting a kind of entity.

original.label: Entity Map
original.description: A capture guide for an entity type that tells an agent what data, relationships, claims, evidence, and preservation rules to expect when extracting or admitting that kind of entity.

subjects.label: Evidence
subjects.description: The source-grounding layer that connects claims and lexicalizations to source material.

original.label: Evidence
original.description: The source-grounding layer that connects claims and lexicalizations to source material.

subjects.label: Evidence Normalization
subjects.description: A distillation process step that links source evidence to the specific claims, labels, or records it supports instead of treating evidence as ontology itself.

original.label: Evidence Normalization
original.description: A distillation process step that links source evidence to the specific claims, labels, or records it supports instead of treating evidence as ontology itself.

subjects.label: Extraction
subjects.description: A distillation phase that converts prepared source material into candidate subjects, claims, relationships, evidence, and supporting semantic data.

original.label: Extraction
original.description: A distillation phase that converts prepared source material into candidate subjects, claims, relationships, evidence, and supporting semantic data.

subjects.label: Hierarchy
subjects.description: The principle of hierarchy holds that concepts and entities organize into levels of generality, where lower items inherit from and belong to higher ones.

merged_subjects.label: Edge Type

subjects.label: Identity
subjects.description: The principle of identity holds that each real-world entity corresponds to exactly one canonical representation in the system

subjects.label: Intake
subjects.description: An operation in the Preparation phase where a source enters the system and its provenance, class, origin, authorship, and date are recorded before meaning is extracted.

subjects.label: Knowledge Distillation
subjects.description: The Memoria concept for source-to-graph knowledge transformation.

original.label: Knowledge Distillation

merged_subjects.label: Distillation
merged_subjects.reason: Merge vague Distillation node into Knowledge Distillation.

subjects.label: Lexicalization

original.description: The layer that records names, aliases, acronyms, and source labels without collapsing them into identity.

subjects.label: Materialization
subjects.description: A distillation process phase that generates indexes, domain markdown, subject cards, checkout bundles, and other read surfaces from canonical state.

subjects.label: Ontology
subjects.description: The schema layer that defines domain concepts and relationships.

subjects.label: Polysemy
subjects.description: The condition where one word, label, or expression can carry multiple meanings depending on context.

original.label: Polysemy
original.description: The condition where one word, label, or expression can carry multiple meanings depending on context.

subjects.label: Preparation
subjects.description: The pre-extraction phase that makes source material ready for distillation.

original.label: Node Promotion

subjects.label: Provenance
subjects.description: The origin and lineage context of material, including where it came from and how it moved through the system.

subjects.label: Salience
subjects.description: The principle of deciding what matters from a perspective with stakes.

subjects.label: Source
subjects.description: External material as it arrives before interpretation, such as a document, page, transcript, export, or file.

subjects.label: Subject

original.label: Claim Extraction
original.description: A distillation process step that turns source material into explicit propositions while preserving causal, temporal, ordered, contradictory, and uncertain structure.

original.label: Admission
original.description: The process of governing admission to a knowledge base or knowledge graph.

original.label: Claim Merge
original.description: A distillation process step that merges accepted claims into canonical state without deleting prior valid claims.

original.label: Context Proposal
original.description: A distillation process step that proposes groupings, domain candidates, and subdomain suggestions without making them canonical automatically.

original.label: Context Curation
original.description: A distillation process step that reviews and curates context changes, including domain proposals and domain hierarchy changes.

original.label: Context
original.description: A grouping or scope structure over subjects and claims, including curated domains, curated collections, inferred clusters, and checkout bundles.

original.label: Claim
original.description: The durable proposition layer that records statements about subjects, relations, attributes, temporal conditions, contradictions, or open questions.

original.label: Evidence Normalization
original.description: A distillation process step that links source evidence to the specific claims, labels, or records it supports instead of treating evidence as ontology itself.

original.label: Entity Map
original.description: A capture guide for an entity type that tells an agent what data, relationships, claims, evidence, and preservation rules to expect when extracting or admitting that kind of entity.

original.label: Extraction
original.description: A distillation phase that converts prepared source material into candidate subjects, claims, relationships, evidence, and supporting semantic data.

original.label: Evidence
original.description: The source-grounding layer that connects claims and lexicalizations to source material.

original.label: First-Class Relationships
original.description: A knowledge distillation principle that treats relationships as durable graph objects with their own extraction, evidence, admission, directionality, and type vocabulary.

original.label: Knowledge Distillation
original.description: A methodology for turning source material into durable canonical knowledge through identity-stable subjects, provenance-bearing claims, curated contexts, evidence, and materialized views.

original.label: Subject
original.description: The canonical identity record for a unique thing a knowledge system knows about.

original.label: Relationship Admission
original.description: An admission process that evaluates candidate relationships independently from their endpoint nodes before allowing them into canonical graph state.

original.label: Lexicalization
original.description: The layer that records names, aliases, acronyms, and source labels without collapsing them into identity.

original.label: Identity Reconciliation
original.description: A distillation process step that resolves incoming subjects or graph-node candidates against canonical identities using bounded review outcomes.

original.label: Relationship Extraction
original.description: A distillation process that identifies typed, directional relationships between candidate nodes and preserves the evidence that justifies them.

original.label: Preperation
original.description: A pre-extraction process that converts source documents into an efficient working format, then cleans formatting noise, navigation chrome, boilerplate, and low-signal scaffolding before extraction.

original.label: Lexicalization Normalization
original.description: A distillation process step that separates labels, aliases, acronyms, and source names from canonical identity.

original.label: Subject Extraction
original.description: A distillation process step that identifies candidate referents in source material without forcing premature structure.

original.label: Read View Materialization
original.description: A distillation process phase that generates indexes, domain markdown, subject cards, checkout bundles, and other read surfaces from canonical state.

original.label: Polysemy
original.description: The condition where one word, label, or expression can carry multiple meanings depending on context.
